related.title: 汽輪發電機製造
related.why: 共用同步機與絕緣原理
related.transfer: 共用同步機與絕緣原理
related.difference: 發電機供有功而調相機主要耗損補償
related.differenceEn: Generators supply active power; condensers mainly cover losses
practice: 以「無軸功輸入」為起點，畫出本課與「汽輪發電機製造」可共用及須重畫的系統邊界。
針對「發電機供有功而調相機主要耗損補償」各選一項能區分兩課的量測。
將本課算例移植到新情境：保留方程依據，重新指定單位、材料或拓撲，並標示無法沿用的數值。
practiceEn: Start from no shaft-power input and mark shared/redefined boundaries with steam-turbine generator manufacturing.
For the difference "Generators supply active power; condensers mainly cover losses", choose discriminating measurements for both courses.
Transfer the worked example: retain justified equations, respecify units, materials or topology and identify values that cannot transfer.
